stations.title: Agnieszka
stations.say: Why does the card still say Hettie?

stations.title: Your fix
stations.gap: Runs too rarely, then too often

stations.title: Member card
stations.text: The pass and the swims this season.

captions: Next, Agnieszka picks Delphine at the desk, and the card still shows Hettie.
The card never asks for the member picked, and + logs a swim again and again.
You mend two effects and keep the card calm while a note is typed, in three tasks.
Delphine is picked, her answer comes, and the card shows her.
Same members, same keyboard. Each effect now runs when it should, and only then.
